what: The frozen TCGA reference the T4/T5 tropism score AND patient modifiers are standardised against (pre-registration item 11(h)). Never rebuilt from a CGGA statistic.
symbol_collapse: counts of every Ensembl id sharing a GENCODE gene_name are summed
scale_rationale: FPKM, not CPM, because the cohort this reference standardises (CGGA) publishes RSEM FPKM. On these same 284 samples a CPM reference offsets the score by -1.36 SD for the NSC panel and -1.47 SD for TGFB1, cutting the engrafted-dose factor by about a third for every patient. Item 11(h) names no normalisation, so matching the scoring cohort is an implementation choice inside the registered design.
caveat_remaining: TCGA's FPKM here is GDC's STAR-derived fpkm_unstranded; CGGA's is RSEM FPKM. Both are length-normalised, so the first-order gene-length offset is removed, but a second-order pipeline difference remains and is reported, not corrected.
